proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under U->2U, L->3L (Pk,UgradP,eps ~L2/T3; DUDt,Snorm*Umag,omega*sqrt(k) ~L/T2); denominators use eps>0 or omega*sqrt(k)>0 so finite on >99% cell-centers (no wall-face zeros); orderings differ from q_ti/q_pgrad/q_tscale/q_pnorm/q_qcrit (signed work, Pk/eps magnitude, acceleration vs shear); risk is Pk/eps outliers compressing median norm and freestream 0-values, mitigated by bounded forms for other two.

features.name: f_neq
features.rationale: Production-to-dissipation non-equilibrium; Pk>>eps in separated shear layers and Pk<0 on reattachment flags where SST Boussinesq anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_apgwork
features.rationale: Signed adverse-pressure work vs turbulence production+dissipation; positive in APG separation, negative in FPG acceleration of bumps and CD channel.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Bulk acceleration vs shear advection plus turbulence scale; flags curvature, separation/reattachment and converging-diverging acceleration where equilibrium SST fails.

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under U->2U, L->3L (L2/T3 vs L2/T3; L/T2 vs L/T2); denominators >0 off-wall (eps>0, k*Snorm>=0, W*U+omega*sqrt(k)>0) so finite; ordering distinct from q_pgrad/q_tscale/f_apgwork/f_accel (signed APG magnitude, production efficiency, rotation-vs-acceleration); wall limit finite at cell-centers, freestream ->0; no log/exp blow-up; collinearity risk low.

features.name: f_apgStrain
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs shear-turbulence scale; positive in APG separation bubble, negative in FPG throat acceleration of CD channel and bumps.

features.name: f_prodEff
features.rationale: Production efficiency per shear-turbulence energy; high in separated shear layer, negative in counter-gradient reattachment where Boussinesq anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_bendAcc
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs rotation-advection plus turbulence scale; separates curved recirculation (rotation-dominated) from throat acceleration and separation onset.

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless (L-T: UgradP,k*Snorm,eps=L2/T3; Snorm,omega=1/T; gradk,omega*sqrt(k)=L/T2), bounded in [0,1] or [-1,1] via positive denominators (eps>0, omega>0) so finite except possible 0/0 at exact wall, expected <1%; orderings distinct from q_ti/f_neq/f_bendAcc targeting APG sign, rapid-strain and k-transport edges driving CD-channel error; drop 3 zero-gain overlapping f_* to avoid collinearity and keep slots.

features.name: f_apgBal
features.rationale: Signed APG vs shear+dissipation scale; +1 in APG separation bubble, -1 in FPG throat acceleration of CD-channel/bumps where SST anisotropy wrong.

features.name: f_strainFreq
features.rationale: Rapid strain vs turbulence frequency; ~1 in separated shear layer and throat (non-equilibrium production far from dissipation), ~0 in equilibrium freestream.

features.name: f_kInhom
features.rationale: Relative k-inhomogeneity vs local turbulence scale; flags shear-layer edges and reattachment transport zones where gradient-diffusion and Boussinesq fail.

features: x / (1 + x), x = sqrt(k) / (0.09 omega d)

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (L^2/T^2 vs L^2/T^2, L^2/T vs L^2/T, L/T^2 vs L/T^2); denominators >0 off-wall (k>0, omega*sqrt(k)>0, nut>=0) so finite on >99%; ordering distinct from f_bendAcc/f_apgBal/q_wall but f_accStrain partly collinear with f_bendAcc (Snorm vs Wnorm) and f_pgWall magnitude-only to complement signed f_apgBal; bounded/median-scaled so no blow-up; drop f_strainFreq which is used but hurts heldout.

features.name: f_recAdv
features.rationale: Local wall-advection Reynolds 0-1; ~0 in low-momentum recirculation bubble even off-wall, ~1 in throat/outer flow, separates SST failure in separation vs attached shear.

features.name: f_pgWall
features.rationale: Clauser-like wall-scaled pressure-gradient vs local kinetic energy; peaks near-wall in APG separation and FPG throat of CD-channel/bumps where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_accStrain
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs strain-advection plus turbulence frequency; ~1 at separation onset and throat curvature/non-equilibrium, ~0 in equilibrium shear, complements Wnorm-based f_bendAcc.

features: Wnorm * d / (Umag + Wnorm * d + omega * d + sqrt(k))

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (numerator and denominator scale identically: L2/T3, L2/T2, L/T). Finite: f_advTrans denominator includes eps>0 always finite; f_eddyStress 0/0 only at no-slip wall (<1% points); f_rotWall denominator includes omega*d>0 even at wall so 100% finite. None constant; orderings target CD-channel separation bubble vs FPG throat. No duplication of I1/I2 or q_qcrit rotation ratio; complements kept q_ti, f_neq, f_bendAcc.

features.name: f_advTrans
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs production+dissipation; + in accelerating transport ahead of separation, - at reattachment where advection balances dissipation and SST local-equilibrium anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_eddyStress
features.rationale: Eddy-viscosity stress scale vs k; high where SST Boussinesq is over-active in throat shear, low in low-momentum bubble, flags where anisotropy magnitude correction is needed.

features.name: f_rotWall
features.formula: Wnorm * d / (Umag + Wnorm * d + omega * d + sqrt(k))
features.rationale: Rotation-times-wall-distance vs advection plus turbulent/wall frequencies; high in curved recirculation bubble, low in FPG throat and outer flow, separates curvature/APG failure from attached shear.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed ratios are dimensionless (numerator/denominator share L^2/T^3, 1/T, L/T^2 respectively) so invariant to velocity*2/length*3 scaling; denominators contain strictly-positive omega or eps/abs sums so finite on >99% of cells (only isolated zero-turbulence zero-gradient points risky); bounded signed forms avoid outliers; overlap risk: f_apgBal complements f_advTrans (pressure vs k-advection) and f_neq (Pk/eps magnitude without APG sign), f_curvSW complements f_bendAcc/f_rotWall (local S-vs-W without d/Umag wall singularities); drop of 3 zero-gain features frees slots without losing best-formula terms.

features.name: f_apgBal
features.rationale: Signed APG/FPG power vs turbulence production+dissipation; + near diffuser/bump APG separation onset, - in FPG throat/reattachment where SST equilibrium fails.

features.name: f_curvSW
features.rationale: Strain-dominated vs rotation-dominated shear; negative in curved recirculation bubble, near-zero in attached shear, positive in throat straining where SST curvature response is wrong.

features.name: f_pgShear
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs mean-shear advection plus turbulent stress rate; high in APG separation/reattachment zones, low in attached and free-shear flow.

features: UgradP * d / (Umag * (0.5 * Umag * Umag + k) + eps * d)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under velocity*2 length*3 scaling; denominators use eps*d or sums of positive scales so >0 off-wall (d>0, eps>0) ensuring finite; bounded or flux-regularized to avoid wall singularities; orderings distinct from q_ti/f_neq/f_bendAcc and replace dropped 0-gain APG/curvature features without duplicating I1/I2.

features.name: f_apgWall
features.formula: UgradP * d / (Umag * (0.5 * Umag * Umag + k) + eps * d)
features.rationale: Signed wall-weighted APG power vs mean-flow energy flux plus dissipation; positive in near-wall APG separation onset, negative in FPG throat/reattachment.

features.name: f_kAdv
features.rationale: Streamwise advection of k vs local production+dissipation; flags non-equilibrium history effects in separated shear layer growth and reattachment.

features.name: f_wallShear
features.rationale: Wall-scaled shear vs velocity and turbulence scales; separates near-wall attached/separating shear from free shear and outer flow.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless checked (V->2V,L->3L invariant). Denominators >0 interior (omega>0,d>0,eps>0 at cell centers) so finite ~100%; wall-face 0/0 avoided as data are cell-centered. f_apgBal overlaps f_kAdv family but uses pressure power (APG/FPG) not k-advection, low collinearity with f_neq (ratio vs bounded signed ratio). f_rot uses only 1/T scales, distinct from f_bendAcc which includes acceleration. f_turbLen uses omega*d vs f_wallShear d*Snorm, complementary strain vs turbulence scale. Bounded/monotonic so median-normalization preserves ordering. Risk of APG denominator ~0 at wall mitigated by eps>0 interior; drop only zero-use zero-gain features, retain f_wallShear despite -0.0024 as active in best and within noise.

features.name: f_apgBal
features.rationale: Signed APG/FPG power vs production+dissipation; positive in APG separation onset, negative in FPG throat/reattachment where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_rot
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain imbalance; positive in curved recirculation, negative in accelerating strained throat to flag curvature errors.

features.name: f_turbLen
features.rationale: Turbulent length sqrt(k)/omega vs wall distance; separates near-wall attached shear from outer free-shear separation.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked L-T dimensionless (invariant under V*2, L*3): f_brad (L2/T*L2/T2 ratio), f_apgDir (L2/T3 over L2/T3), f_advK (L2/T3 over L2/T3); denominators strictly >0 via +eps so finite even at wall/stagnation (Umag=0, d=0). Bounded or positive, non-constant orderings distinct from f_neq/f_bendAcc. Risk: f_brad correlates with f_neq via Pk~nut S^2 (mitigated by different S dependence); f_apgDir replaces dropped f_apgBal with cleaner directional normalization to avoid magnitude conflation; f_advK adds new advection history physics missing from active set. Drop only unused zero-gain features to reduce search space; retain f_wallShear despite -0.0 gain because it is structurally used in current best T1 and removal would churn best before replacement is found.

features.name: f_brad
features.rationale: SST eddy-viscosity ratio to equilibrium k/omega; <1 where strain limiter damps nut, flagging APG/separated shear where Boussinesq anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_apgDir
features.rationale: Signed pressure-gradient alignment (+APG/-FPG) independent of magnitude; separates APG separation onset from FPG throat acceleration in converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_advK
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs production+dissipation; flags non-local history and non-equilibrium in separated shear layer and reattachment where local Pk/eps alone fails.

features: d * gradp_mag / (k + Umag * Umag + nut * Snorm)

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L; denominators use k+Umag^2+nut*Snorm, omega*d+Umag+sqrt(k), |UgradP|+|Pk|+eps which are >0 at cell-centers so finite on >99% points; wall-exact 0/0 at most <1%; bounded/normalized forms preserve ordering under x/(|x|+median); complements f_neq/f_bendAcc/f_wallShear (magnitude vs direction, length vs shear) without duplicating I1/I2.

features.name: f_pgWall
features.formula: d * gradp_mag / (k + Umag * Umag + nut * Snorm)
features.rationale: Wall-scaled pressure force vs kinetic plus turbulent stress; flags APG separation onset and FPG throat acceleration in converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_lenWall
features.rationale: Turbulent to wall-plus-advection scale separating near-wall attached/separating shear from free separated shear and outer flow.

features.name: f_pgWork
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs production plus dissipation; flags APG energy overwhelming turbulence at separation versus recovery at reattachment.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under independent velocity/length scaling (num/denom both L^2/T^3 or L/T^2); denominators contain eps or omega*sqrt(k)>0 so finite except possibly at wall centers, expected >99% finite; bounded/mapped so scale-invariant; f_apgAlign is pure mean-flow alignment complementary to f_pgWork and f_neq, f_kAdv captures advective non-equilibrium vs Pk/eps, f_curvAdv vanishes in simple shear (S~W) and near wall (Umag->0) to avoid redundancy with I1/I2 and f_bendAcc; drop f_wallShear (negative heldout_gain, overfit) and unused zero-gain features to free slots.

features.name: f_apgAlign
features.rationale: Signed cosine of U vs grad-p; +1 adverse, -1 favorable; locates APG separation onset vs FPG throat acceleration in converging-diverging channel.

features.name: f_kAdv
features.rationale: Streamwise advection of k vs local production/dissipation; flags non-equilibrium transport in separated shear layers and reattachment recovery.

features.name: f_curvAdv
features.rationale: Off-wall strain-rotation imbalance (curvature/extensional separation) vs acceleration and turbulence scale; zero in simple shear and at wall.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas unit-checked L-T: UgradP/(gradp*sqrt(k)+eps) is (L2/T3)/(L2/T3); abs(S-W)/(S+W+omega) is (1/T)/(1/T); sqrt(k)/(sqrt(k)+omega*d) is (L/T)/(L/T) so invariant to U*2 L*3. Finite: denominators are >0 wherever eps>0 and omega>0 (true for SST): pgWork denom=eps where k=0, curve denom>=omega>0 even in freestream S=W=0, wallTurb denom=omega*d>0 at wall where sqrt(k)=0, so no 0/0 except pathological exact-zero points <1%. Bounded/order-preserving after x/(|x|+med) mapping. Drops are safe: f_apgAlign,f_kAdv,f_curvAdv have terms_using=0 and heldout_gain=0 so best formula (uses only f_neq,f_bendAcc) unchanged. New features complement f_neq/Pk-eps and f_bendAcc: signed pressure-work vs unsigned cosine, simple S-W imbalance vs complex curvAdv, wall-vs-shear peak vs no wall sensor. Risk: pgWork may correlate with f_neq in APG zones but sign distinguishes FPG throat vs APG separation in CD-channel/bumps; mitigated by keeping f_neq.

features.name: f_pgWork
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs pressure-gradient turbulent scale plus dissipation; +1 APG separation, -1 FPG throat acceleration in converging-diverging channel and bumps.

features.name: f_strainRot
features.rationale: Strain-rotation imbalance normalized by turbulence frequency; zero in simple shear, large in curved recirculation and extensional throat where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_wallTurb
features.rationale: Turbulent velocity vs wall-distance frequency; zero at wall and freestream, peaks in separated shear layers to separate near-wall vs free-shear SST errors.

proposal.risk_audit: All three formulas checked dimensionless (L-T): UgradP*d/(k*Umag+eps*d)= (L3/T3)/(L3/T3), UgradK/(abs(Pk)+eps)= (L2/T3)/(L2/T3), Snorm*d/(sqrt(k)+Umag)= (L/T)/(L/T); denominators >0 off-wall (eps*d>0, eps>0, Umag>0) so finite on >99% cell-centers, wall 0/0 not in data; orderings distinct from f_neq (production ratio) and f_bendAcc (acceleration/rotation), median scaling bounds large freestream values; dropping f_pgWork/f_strainRot (gain 0 unused) and f_wallTurb (gain -0.0004) frees slots without losing heldout skill.

features.name: f_apgWall
features.rationale: Signed pressure work weighted by wall distance; +1 APG separation bubble vs -1 FPG throat acceleration in converging-diverging channel and bumps.

features.name: f_kConv
features.rationale: Convection of k vs local production plus dissipation; flags non-local transport in separated shear layers and reattachment where SST equilibrium fails.

features.name: f_shearLay
features.rationale: Wall-distance shear vs turbulent plus mean velocity; peaks in detached shear layers, low in attached boundary layer and freestream.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (1/T ratios, U-scale ratios, S*k/eps), finite (omega>0 and omega*d+sqrt(k)>0 everywhere; eps>0 on >99% like f_neq), non-constant; f_curve complements I1/I2 with rotation-vs-strain ordering for curvature/recirculation, f_lenWall adds wall-vs-free-shear lengthscale missing from active set, f_sTime adds rapid-strain timescale distinct from Pk/eps nut-dependent non-equilibrium; low collinearity risk with f_neq/f_bendAcc, no wall-distance singularity beyond accepted level.

features.name: f_curve
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain plus turbulence frequency; high in curved recirculation cores, ~0.5 in attached shear, low in strained throat acceleration.

features.name: f_lenWall
features.rationale: Turbulent lengthscale vs wall distance; near 0 at wall and freestream, peaks in detached free shear layers where SST mis-predicts.

features.name: f_sTime
features.rationale: Shear timescale vs turbulence timescale for rapid distortion and APG separation onset, independent of nut unlike Pk/eps.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless under velocity*2/length*3 scaling (L2/T3 vs L/T2 groups); finite except exact-wall 0/0 for signed ratios (<1% points, like existing Pk/eps) and strictly finite for pGrad ratio with gradp in denominator; bounded/monotonic orderings distinct from Pk/eps and Snorm*d. Redundancy low: no active feature uses UgradP, gradp_mag or UgradK, addressing worst heldout converging_diverging_channel APG/FPG and reattachment gap. Overfit risk mitigated by dropping 3 unused zero-gain features; retaining f_shearLay despite -0.0 gain because terms_using=1 and gain is round-off zero, to be re-evaluated after APG features enter search.

features.name: f_apgDir
features.rationale: Signed APG vs FPG sensor (U.grad p >0 adverse); separates diverging deceleration/separation from converging throat acceleration where SST anisotropy error changes sign.

features.name: f_pGradBal
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs shear-advection plus turbulence frequency in [0,1]; peaks at separation onset, throat and reattachment, low in equilibrium shear.

features.name: f_kAdv
features.rationale: Signed advection of k vs local production scale; positive in growing detached shear layer, negative in reattachment/recovery where Pk/eps alone is ambiguous.
